title: Evaluation on a freshly named root is refused (named_root_sighting_required): quiet host-delivered turns there are recorded only as unadmitted observations, so no admitted sighting ever exists
outcome: Evaluation on a freshly named root is refused (named_root_sighting_required): quiet host-delivered turns there are recorded only as unadmitted observations, so no admitted sighting ever exists
acceptance: After a claim names a fresh clean source root, an ordinary host-delivered turn in that root (or another defined, documented step that needs no source edit) produces the acknowledged measured sighting termal_evaluate_acceptance requires, so an evaluation can be requested for landed work with no new code change; a test drives naming a fresh clean root, one quiet turn, and an evaluation request that is admitted.

If some step other than a quiet turn is required (for example a registered check), the named_root_sighting_required refusal names that step exactly, and the documented evaluation procedure says so; a test shows the refusal text.
No turn gating is reintroduced: ordinary turns still never call turn_evaluate, turn_begin or a grant.
